title: Aerospace & Defense
painPoint: Aerospace and defense systems demand magnetic components that survive extreme thermal cycling, high-G shock, and prolonged radiation exposure. Standard NdFeB grades like N42 and N52 suffer irreversible flux loss above 80°C, while defense actuators and satellite positioning mechanisms routinely operate in temperature swings from -60°C to +200°C. Designers struggle with demagnetization when high-coercivity grades such as 42SH, 35UH, and 30EH are improperly specified for mission-critical torque motors and harmonic drives. Weight constraints further complicate magnetic circuit optimization, where every gram saved in a magnetic latching system translates to fuel or payload gains. Sourcing consistent magnetic performance across production lots for flight-critical applications remains a persistent supply chain challenge.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers mission-grade NdFeB magnets engineered for aerospace reliability. Our 42SH, 35UH, and 30EH grades maintain stable flux output across -65°C to +200°C thermal cycles, verified by accelerated aging and salt-spray testing per ASTM standards. We provide full magnetic characterization reports, including demagnetization curves, recoil permeability, and temperature coefficient data, for every production lot. Our precision grinding and multi-segment ring assembly capabilities enable optimized magnetic circuits for torque motors, gyroscopes, and magnetic latching systems. With ITAR-compliant documentation and lot traceability, YOUJIU ensures consistent supply for flight-critical programs.
